item.title: Solved: Why do I get AttributeError 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'something'?
item.description:
I am encountering the error message:

AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'something'

This post aims to unravel the intricacies of this particular error, highlighting significant causes of AttributeError due to NoneType objects and providing methods for troubleshooting.

What Causes This Error?

The error signifies that a variable you are trying to use is set to None, and you’re attempting to access an attribute or method on that variable. There are several scenarios that might lead to encountering this error. Let’s explore some common ones.
